quests.title: Kano Nana's Healthy Diet

dialogue.sit: Were you looking for some Carrots?

dialogue.t: Kids have gotta learn to eat their vegetables if they want to grow up. You can't be a picky eater, even when it comes to Carrots.
Anyway. You must be the one who accepted my commission? Do you have 15 Carrots for me?
Good, great, excellent. This time, I'm gonna watch that kid until she's eaten every last mouthful.

quests.description: Narukami Island’s Kano Nana would like to have 15 carrots.
